definition: Core findings for lose weight and burn fat

findings.title: Reducing excess calorie intake
findings.clinicalMeaning: Your current eating habits suggest you are likely consuming more calories than your body burns, making fat loss difficult.
findings.userExplanation: Your current eating habits suggest you are likely consuming more calories than your body burns, making fat loss difficult.

findings.title: Poor Portion Control
findings.clinicalMeaning: Large or inconsistent portion sizes may be adding excess calories even when food choices appear healthy.
findings.userExplanation: Large or inconsistent portion sizes may be adding excess calories even when food choices appear healthy.

findings.title: Excess Liquid Calories
findings.clinicalMeaning: Sugar-sweetened beverages may be adding significant calories without helping you feel full.
findings.userExplanation: Sugar-sweetened beverages may be adding significant calories without helping you feel full.

findings.title: Frequent Restaurant Meals
findings.clinicalMeaning: Frequent restaurant or takeaway meals may increase calorie intake while reducing overall nutritional quality.
findings.userExplanation: Frequent restaurant or takeaway meals may increase calorie intake while reducing overall nutritional quality.

findings.title: Low Protein Intake
findings.clinicalMeaning: Your protein intake may not be sufficient to support satiety and preserve muscle during fat loss.
findings.userExplanation: Your protein intake may not be sufficient to support satiety and preserve muscle during fat loss.

findings.title: Frequent Snacking
findings.clinicalMeaning: Frequent snacking outside of genuine hunger may be increasing your daily calorie intake.
findings.userExplanation: Frequent snacking outside of genuine hunger may be increasing your daily calorie intake.

findings.title: Poor Meal Timing
findings.clinicalMeaning: Late-night or inconsistent eating patterns may make it harder to maintain healthy eating habits.
findings.userExplanation: Late-night or inconsistent eating patterns may make it harder to maintain healthy eating habits.

findings.title: Weekend Calorie Surplus
findings.clinicalMeaning: Weekend eating habits may be undoing the healthy progress made during the rest of the week.
findings.userExplanation: Weekend eating habits may be undoing the healthy progress made during the rest of the week.

findings.title: Low Daily Movement
findings.clinicalMeaning: Low daily movement reduces overall calorie expenditure and slows fat-loss progress.
findings.userExplanation: Low daily movement reduces overall calorie expenditure and slows fat-loss progress.

findings.title: Sedentary Lifestyle
findings.clinicalMeaning: Long periods of sitting reduce daily energy expenditure and contribute to poor metabolic health.
findings.userExplanation: Long periods of sitting reduce daily energy expenditure and contribute to poor metabolic health.

findings.title: Inadequate Strength Training
findings.clinicalMeaning: Without regular resistance training, you may lose muscle along with body fat.
findings.userExplanation: Without regular resistance training, you may lose muscle along with body fat.

findings.title: Low Cardio Activity
findings.clinicalMeaning: Limited cardiovascular exercise may reduce your total weekly calorie expenditure.
findings.userExplanation: Limited cardiovascular exercise may reduce your total weekly calorie expenditure.

findings.title: Low Non-Exercise Activity
findings.clinicalMeaning: Daily movement outside of structured exercise appears to be lower than recommended.
findings.userExplanation: Daily movement outside of structured exercise appears to be lower than recommended.

findings.title: Low Activity Routine
findings.clinicalMeaning: Your daily routine may not provide enough movement to support efficient fat loss.
findings.userExplanation: Your daily routine may not provide enough movement to support efficient fat loss.

findings.title: High Sugar Cravings
findings.clinicalMeaning: Frequent sugar cravings can make maintaining a calorie deficit much more challenging.
findings.userExplanation: Frequent sugar cravings can make maintaining a calorie deficit much more challenging.

findings.title: Poor Appetite Control
findings.clinicalMeaning: Feeling hungry soon after meals suggests that your meals may not be keeping you satisfied for long.
findings.userExplanation: Feeling hungry soon after meals suggests that your meals may not be keeping you satisfied for long.

findings.title: Energy Instability
findings.clinicalMeaning: Afternoon energy crashes may reflect inconsistent nutrition or recovery.
findings.userExplanation: Afternoon energy crashes may reflect inconsistent nutrition or recovery.

findings.title: Fat Loss Plateau
findings.clinicalMeaning: Your current approach may have reached a plateau, indicating that adjustments are needed rather than simply trying harder.
findings.userExplanation: Your current approach may have reached a plateau, indicating that adjustments are needed rather than simply trying harder.

findings.title: Compensatory Eating
findings.clinicalMeaning: Skipping meals followed by overeating can disrupt appetite regulation and increase total calorie intake.
findings.userExplanation: Skipping meals followed by overeating can disrupt appetite regulation and increase total calorie intake.

findings.title: Sleep Deficit
findings.clinicalMeaning: Insufficient sleep may increase hunger, reduce recovery, and make healthy choices more difficult.
findings.userExplanation: Insufficient sleep may increase hunger, reduce recovery, and make healthy choices more difficult.

findings.title: High Stress Load
findings.clinicalMeaning: Ongoing stress can influence appetite, cravings, recovery, and long-term fat-loss success.
findings.userExplanation: Ongoing stress can influence appetite, cravings, recovery, and long-term fat-loss success.

findings.title: Poor Recovery
findings.clinicalMeaning: Not feeling refreshed after sleep suggests your body may not be recovering optimally.
findings.userExplanation: Not feeling refreshed after sleep suggests your body may not be recovering optimally.

findings.title: Low Daily Energy
findings.clinicalMeaning: Low energy throughout the day may reduce physical activity and consistency with healthy habits.
findings.userExplanation: Low energy throughout the day may reduce physical activity and consistency with healthy habits.

findings.title: Emotional Eating Pattern
findings.clinicalMeaning: Food appears to be used for emotional comfort rather than physical hunger, making consistent fat loss more difficult.
findings.userExplanation: Food appears to be used for emotional comfort rather than physical hunger, making consistent fat loss more difficult.

findings.title: Behavioural Barrier
findings.clinicalMeaning: Your biggest reported obstacle represents a genuine barrier that should be addressed as part of your fat-loss strategy.
findings.userExplanation: Your biggest reported obstacle represents a genuine barrier that should be addressed as part of your fat-loss strategy.

findings.title: High Readiness For Change
findings.clinicalMeaning: Your commitment suggests you are mentally prepared to make meaningful lifestyle improvements.
findings.userExplanation: Your commitment suggests you are mentally prepared to make meaningful lifestyle improvements.

findings.title: Reducing excess calorie intake
findings.clinicalMeaning: Several eating habits together suggest that your daily calorie intake is consistently exceeding your energy needs.
findings.userExplanation: Several eating habits together suggest that your daily calorie intake is consistently exceeding your energy needs.

findings.title: Poor Fat Loss Environment
findings.clinicalMeaning: A combination of nutrition, inactivity, and recovery factors is creating an environment that makes fat loss significantly harder.
findings.userExplanation: A combination of nutrition, inactivity, and recovery factors is creating an environment that makes fat loss significantly harder.

findings.title: Muscle Preservation Risk
findings.clinicalMeaning: Low protein intake combined with limited resistance training increases the likelihood of losing muscle during weight loss.
findings.userExplanation: Low protein intake combined with limited resistance training increases the likelihood of losing muscle during weight loss.

findings.title: Recovery Limited Progress
findings.clinicalMeaning: Poor sleep together with high stress may be reducing recovery and making healthy behaviours harder to maintain.
findings.userExplanation: Poor sleep together with high stress may be reducing recovery and making healthy behaviours harder to maintain.

findings.title: Metabolic Strain
findings.clinicalMeaning: Frequent cravings, energy crashes, and poor satiety suggest your current eating pattern is making appetite regulation more difficult.
findings.userExplanation: Frequent cravings, energy crashes, and poor satiety suggest your current eating pattern is making appetite regulation more difficult.

findings.title: Weekend Compensation Pattern
findings.clinicalMeaning: Healthier weekday habits may be offset by less structured eating on weekends.
findings.userExplanation: Healthier weekday habits may be offset by less structured eating on weekends.

findings.title: Emotional Overeating Pattern
findings.clinicalMeaning: Emotional eating combined with mindless snacking creates a recurring pattern that can significantly increase calorie intake.
findings.userExplanation: Emotional eating combined with mindless snacking creates a recurring pattern that can significantly increase calorie intake.

findings.title: Low Fat Loss Efficiency
findings.clinicalMeaning: Multiple lifestyle factors are working together to reduce the efficiency of your fat-loss efforts.
findings.userExplanation: Multiple lifestyle factors are working together to reduce the efficiency of your fat-loss efforts.

findings.title: Strong Behavioural Foundation
findings.clinicalMeaning: Although some habits need improvement, your motivation and commitment provide an excellent foundation for long-term success.
findings.userExplanation: Although some habits need improvement, your motivation and commitment provide an excellent foundation for long-term success.

findings.title: High Success Potential
findings.clinicalMeaning: Your current mindset and readiness indicate a strong potential to achieve meaningful fat-loss results with consistent action.
findings.userExplanation: Your current mindset and readiness indicate a strong potential to achieve meaningful fat-loss results with consistent action.

findings.title: Hidden Calorie Pattern
findings.clinicalMeaning: Calories from drinks, restaurant meals, and weekends may be preventing fat loss despite healthy intentions.
findings.userExplanation: Calories from drinks, restaurant meals, and weekends may be preventing fat loss despite healthy intentions.

findings.title: Appetite Dysregulation
findings.clinicalMeaning: Your eating pattern may be making it difficult to feel satisfied, increasing the risk of overeating.
findings.userExplanation: Your eating pattern may be making it difficult to feel satisfied, increasing the risk of overeating.

findings.title: Low Calorie Expenditure
findings.clinicalMeaning: Your overall daily movement appears too low to effectively support fat loss.
findings.userExplanation: Your overall daily movement appears too low to effectively support fat loss.

findings.title: Low Daily Performance
findings.clinicalMeaning: Reduced energy throughout the day may be limiting your ability to stay active and consistent.
findings.userExplanation: Reduced energy throughout the day may be limiting your ability to stay active and consistent.
